subject.title: feat(signal): add validated interactive setup wizard

question: Should this terminal-only Signal setup slice wait for selected-account native readiness, or should it remove ambiguous external-native and stale-account reuse paths until that readiness work lands?
rationale: The author explicitly calls the readiness work a separate dependency and identifies concrete unsafe paths, so a maintainer must choose the landing boundary rather than treating the current draft as merge-ready.

options.title: Wait for account-aware readiness
options.body: Keep the draft open until selected-account readiness is available and validated with this setup flow.

options.title: Narrow the enabled setup modes
options.body: Remove or disable paths that cannot prove the selected account, allowing only currently verifiable transport modes.

recommendation.title: Wait for account-aware readiness
